translations.answer: Cannot. The response indicates that the physical G1 bottleneck may be in contact dynamics and actuators, rather than frame rate in the generation frame; validation of retargeting, control period, joint limits, and real-time stability is required. At the time, the integrated robot version was not released, so the conclusion is unresolved.
translations.applicability: Applies to migration from animation/simulation generator to real humanoid control stack.
translations.credibility.rationale: The answer has not closed-loop or there is conflict; it is only forming problem clues.
translations.details.attempts.0: The replying party requested to wait for robot integration and perform real-time retargeting validation.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Separate inference latency, contact dynamics, actuator bandwidth and retargeting success rate.
translations.details.environments.0: MotionBricks simulation demonstration; physical G1 is still under integration.
translations.details.limits.0: This is a critical reply, not an experimental report.
translations.details.outcomes.0: No real-time reproduction results have been achieved as of this reply.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: The simulation/rationale performance numbers are mistakenly considered as the control performance of G1.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Actions must be checked for joint limits, velocity/force/torque, contact stability, and fall protection before deployment.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The real bottleneck is in contact and actuators, not rendering/frame rate.
translations.details.symptoms.0: No real-time results, reproducibility is still in progress.
